import java.io.BufferedReader;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStreamReader;
import java.util.StringTokenizer;

public class E {
	
	static long mod=998244353;
	static long[] facts, factInvs;
	
	public static void main(String[] args) {
		initialize();
		ScannerWrapper scanner=new ScannerWrapper();
		try {
		int n=scanner.nextInt(), k=scanner.nextInt();
		if (k==0) {
			System.out.println(facts[n]);
			return;
		}
		if (k>=n) {
			System.out.println(0);
			return;
		}
		int nUsable=n-k;
		long assignWays=powerCalculate(nUsable, n);
		long pickThese=calculateCombination(n, nUsable);
		long ways=multiplay( assignWays, pickThese);
		System.out.println(multiplay(ways, 2));
		}
		catch(Throwable t) {
			System.out.println(0);
		}
	}
	
	static long powerCalculate(int base, long exp) {
		long result=0;
		for (int sub=0; sub<base; sub++) {
			long delta=fastPower(base-sub, exp)*calculateCombination(base, sub);
			if (sub%2==0) {
				result=add(result, delta);
			}
			else {
				result=subtract(result, delta);
			}
		}
		return result;
	}
	
	static void initialize() {
		facts=new long[1_000_000];
		factInvs=new long[1_000_000];
		facts[0]=factInvs[0]=1;
		for (int i=1; i<facts.length; i++) facts[i]=multiplay(facts[i-1], i);
		factInvs[facts.length-1]=fastPower(facts[facts.length-1], mod-2);
		for (int i=factInvs.length-2; i>=0; i--) factInvs[i]=multiplay(factInvs[i+1], i+1);
	}
	
	static long calculateCombination(int n, int k) {
		long ans=multiplay(facts[n], multiplay(factInvs[k], factInvs[n-k]));
		return ans;
	}

	static long add(long a, long b) {
		return (a+b)%mod;
	}
	
	static long subtract(long a, long b) {
		return ((a-b)%mod+mod)%mod;
	}
	
	static long multiplay(long a, long b) {
		return a*b%mod;
	}
	
	static long fastPower(long base, long exp) {
		if (exp==0) return 1;
		long half=fastPower(base, exp/2);
		if (exp%2==0) return multiplay(half, half);
		return multiplay(half, multiplay(half, base));
	}
	
	static class ScannerWrapper {
		BufferedReader br=new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
		StringTokenizer st=new StringTokenizer("");

		public String next() {
			while (!st.hasMoreElements())
				try {
					st=new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
				} catch (IOException e) {
					e.printStackTrace();
				}
			return st.nextToken();
		}

		public int nextInt() {
			return Integer.parseInt(next());
		}

		public long nextLong() {
			return Long.parseLong(next());
		}
	}
}
